result_contract: A source request/pointer is not content fetched, successfully rendered, or a player state update.

actions.description: Home contextual trailhead with only observed scenario markers
Open Story choices (no forced shelf order)
Expand an existing project node with source-grounded stages
Open a child track or feature of the current project only
Detour into a source-linked Atlas group (actual lesson must be fetched by consumer)
Select a story marker observed in the specific synthetic scenario
Open an unobserved dossier for research/replay only, explicitly NOT currently available
Return to immediate previous surface; restore selected source semantics but not ephemeral checkboxes

route_rules: Start on home with named observed choices; unobserved published prerequisites remain candidates, not marker observations.
Open only known direct children of a project/track, not arbitrary cross-graph jump.
Atlas requests only known atlas family IDs; a route link must be an EXPLAINED_BY edge or an explicit user-requested known Atlas group.
Select_mission requires an observed marker in the explicit synthetic scenario; open_mission_reference may bypass availability but must label REFERENCE_ONLY.
A full mission view is only a source request requiring actual original A-to-final reload. No pseudo-briefing or generated Gold tiles.
Return from Atlas to a selected mission issues the SAME full-source reload request; never claim checklist or UI drawer state persisted.
Any critical activated warning appears in navigation metadata even when looking at an Atlas topic.
Return never asserts completed, visited, unlocked, crafted, acquired, Gold or saved.
State changes are scenario fixture replacements, not implicit side effects of clicking.
Do not follow a different agent's foreign path for a state write.

return_semantics.stack: transient in-memory sequence of semantic surfaces

source_limitations: This router does not fetch the original GameGuide or Atlas contents; a request must be executed by a separately authorized reader.
GameGuide source dossiers may contain historical player progress text; do not import those facts into a fictional scenario.
An observed marker in a fixture is not a real-time in-game scan.
Native ChatGPT UI interaction acceptance requires a separate real-client run; tests cover plain data envelopes only.
